title: Conjugation of Thalassiosira pseudonana
author: Jernej Turnsek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f55bq86

steps.title: Prepare bacterial starter culture
steps.instruction: Pick colonies from Gent+Kan plates and inoculate 10 mL LB medium; grow overnight (~16–20 h) to reach OD₆₀₀ ≈2. Measure OD₆₀₀ and inoculate 150 mL fresh LB to a starting OD₆₀₀ of 0.05 or 0.1, grow at 37 °C until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.3–0.4. Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm, 10 °C for 10 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 800 µL SOC.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 10 mL LB with Gent+Kan colonies; overnight growth.
Start 150 mL LB subculture at OD₆₀₀ 0.05–0.1; grow to OD₆₀₀ 0.3–0.4 at 37 °C.
Harvest cells: 4,000 rpm, 10 °C, 10 min; resuspend in 800 µL SOC.

steps.title: Prepare diatom culture
steps.instruction: Grow Thalassiosira pseudonana in L1 medium to a cell density of ~8 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ (acceptable range 4–8 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹). Count cells with a BioRad TC20. Spin down 2 × 10⁸ cells at 4,000 rpm, 10 °C for 10 min, discard supernatant (optionally keep a small volume for later use) and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL L1 medium.

substeps.instruction: Cultivate cells in L1 to ~8 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.
Centrifuge 4,000 rpm, 10 °C, 10 min; resuspend pellet in 1 mL L1 (retain some supernatant if desired).

steps.title: Mix bacteria and diatom cells
steps.instruction: Combine 200 µL of the diatom suspension with 200 µL of the E. coli SOC suspension in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and pipette up and down several times to mix.

steps.title: Plate co‑culture on agar
steps.instruction: Spread the 400 µL mixture onto pre‑dried half‑strength L1 agar plates containing 1 % agar and 5 % LB. Ensure plates are dry, then leave them open at 37 °C for about 1 hour before adding the mixture.

substeps.instruction: Dry half‑strength L1 1 % agar plates with 5 % LB.
Plate the 400 µL bacterial‑diatom mixture onto the dry plates.

steps.title: Incubate in dark
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated co‑culture in the dark at 30 °C for 90 minutes.

steps.title: Shift to standard diatom conditions
steps.instruction: Transfer the plates to standard Thalassiosira pseudonana growth conditions (18 °C, constant light) and incubate for 4 hours.

steps.title: Add medium and scrape cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL L1 medium onto each plate, scrape the surface with a cell scraper or L‑spreader, and collect the resulting suspension (≈500 µL co‑culture).

steps.title: Select transformants on nourseothricin
steps.instruction: Plate 200 µL of the scraped suspension onto pre‑dried half‑strength L1 agar plates containing 1 % agar and 100 µg mL⁻¹ nourseothricin. Incubate at 18 °C under constant light until colonies appear (≈2 weeks).

steps.title: Validate transformants
steps.instruction: Confirm heterologous gene presence and expression by one or more of the following: (1) Grow colonies in liquid L1 with 100 µg mL⁻¹ nourseothricin; (2) PCR using 1 µL diatom culture as template to amplify the expression cassette and E. coli‑specific genes (include positive E. coli control); (3) RT‑PCR on total RNA converted to cDNA with gene‑specific primers; optional: (4) Diatom miniprep, transform E. coli, select on LB + 50 µg mL⁻¹ kanamycin; (5) Western blot or protein‑specific assays.

substeps.instruction: Selection growth in L1 + 100 µg mL⁻¹ nourseothricin.
PCR on diatom DNA (1 µL template) for cassette and donor‑absence checks.
RT‑PCR on cDNA from total RNA.
Optional episome recovery and E. coli transformation (kanamycin 50 µg mL⁻¹).
Optional protein‑level analyses (Western blot, activity assays).
